title: Stabilize config key boundary and command journal evidence
summary: Move core config-key imports to the backend kernel surface, preserve intentionally permissive unknown settings patch behavior, keep malformed queue manifests falling back empty with rewrite coverage, and journal sanitized validation failures for known local API command routes.
reason: The review found config ownership drift and missing tests around intentionally permissive/fallback behavior. Validation-failed command mutations also lacked audit evidence.
behavior_before: Core modules imported config keys from the desktop shim, unknown settings patch behavior was under-specified by tests, malformed priority/file override fallback lacked rewrite coverage, and strict validation failures on known mutation routes returned 400 without command-journal evidence.
behavior_after: Core modules import config keys from mediapipeline.core.kernel.config_keys, settings patch can create/persist unknown keys while reporting unknown_key risk evidence, malformed priority/file override manifests still fall back empty and are rewritten valid on next save, and known command-route validation failures are journaled with sanitized bounded payload summaries.
manual_validation: python -m pytest --version: failed, pytest is not installed in bundled runtime
rollback_plan: Revert this packet by restoring the core config-key imports, settings patch candidate/save behavior, local API validation-failure journaling changes, and the focused regression tests. No source, scratch, output, pending-publish, FFmpeg, subtitle, or audio policy data migrations are involved.
notes: Implements planned config-key boundary cleanup, explicit tests for intentionally permissive unknown-key and malformed-manifest fallback behavior, and sanitized command-journal entries for validation failures on known command routes.
